pages.text: $(bold)Auto Collector$(): consumes Akaishi Energy to automatically $(bold)harvest$() crystal clusters in range, storing the drops (1-2 Akaishi Essence) into an internal $(bold)27-slot$() container. The container uses the standard item interface, so hoppers, AE2 Storage Buses and Mekanism logistic pipes can access it directly.

$(bold)Tier values (range matches the catalyst):$(br)$(li)Basic: 3x3x3 range, 30 ticks/cluster, 2 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5 range, 15 ticks/cluster, 4 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9 range, 7 ticks/cluster, 8 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16 range, 2 ticks/cluster, 16 E/t$(br)$(bold)Note:$() Idles without energy when no cluster is in range; full container keeps the cluster intact.
